status: committed before any V6 selection array existed
parameter_source: Development tuning on seeds 6000..6031 and OOD 8000..8031 (v6_results/tuning/summary.json), chosen by the rule in V6_DESIGN.md: drain_weight from the best drain-only set, restraint parameters from the best drain-plus-restraint set.

seeds.cases: 5100..5131 inclusive: all eleven original families in all six regimes (352 cases per regime)
seeds.ood: 8200..8231 inclusive: all six OOD families of v5_ood.py (192 cases)

arms: static, capacity_v2, capacity_balance, v3_full, v4_hybrid and the frozen v5_full, beside the three eligible variants with the parameters above
rule: For each variant count the failed standing point checks: 36 loss/endpoint checks against capacity_v2 and capacity_balance, 24 risk checks against v3_full, capacity_v2, capacity_balance and v4_hybrid, and the 4 pooled OOD checks against v4_hybrid and capacity_balance. Choose the fewest failures, then the lower delayed_noisy mean total_dropped, then the lower delayed_noisy risk, then the lexicographically first variant ID. Computed by `python v6_grid.py summarize --split selection` from the rows of `python v6_grid.py run --split selection`.
reported: Every variant's point summary, its failed checks and the H1/H2 directions against v5_full are retained whatever the outcome; the choice is never revised after validation.
outputs: v6_results/selection_grid/summary.json (chosen variant, ranking, parameters, SHA-256 of every row file). Rows stay under local_runs/v6_grid/selection/grid.
